description: The pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (Proportion)" represents the distribution of token routing in a system. The chart is divided into three slices, each representing a different routing method. The largest slice, which occupies the majority of the chart, is labeled "LOCAL" and accounts for 94.5% of the total. The second largest slice is labeled "LLM" and represents 3.9% of the total. The smallest slice is labeled "EDGE_P2P" and accounts for 1.6% of the total. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
